Priya (CSM): Need final SLA/SLO comms for trialing customer (Skywell). Deadline: Friday EOD for Legal sign. Who can own the customer one‑pager and the example credit calc?
Diego (Solutions): I can own the one‑pager and include Hosted vs Dedicated notes + degraded‑mode mapping.
Nate (Eng): From runtime telemetry: expect cold p95 ~280ms. Recommend staged p95: 0-14d 280ms, 15-90d 230ms. We'll add caching notes.
Ava (Onboarding): I'll run weekly health emails and host the SRE enablement. Ill also create the alert runbook.
Priya (CSM): OpsBot attach the SLA template and monthly report template please.
OpsBot: Attached: /policies/sla_template_v3.pdf, /reports/slo_monthly_example.xlsx
Diego (Solutions): Draft SLO table for the pager:

Uptime | 99.95% | 30d
Gen p95 | 280ms (0-14d) -> 230ms (15-90d) | 30d rolling
Error rate | <0.3% | 30d

Priya (CSM): Credit example needed. Nate, can you provide worked examples for common shortfalls?
Nate (Eng): Sure. Example: SLO uptime 99.95%, observed 99.80% => shortfall 0.15% => credit = 0.15% * monthly invoice (multiplier 1.0). I'll add a small table.
Maya (Legal): If this diverges from the canonical SLA template, include a one‑line justification.
Diego (Solutions): Will flag deviations (onboarding window, staged latency) and rationale: cache warmup + tuning.
Priya (CSM): Timeline: Diego draft today, Priya review tomorrow AM, Maya legal sign after that, Ava first health email 1 week post‑go‑live. Nate verifies metrics feed by Wed.
Ava (Onboarding): I'll schedule the enablement session and share runbook in #eng-ops.
Priya (CSM): Thanks team. Link tracker: https://redwood.ai/trackers/SKW-457 :thumbsup:
